text: Coffee with Sofia. She's flying to Lima end of the month for her cousin's wedding, 14 hours plus a layover in Madrid. Her mum's knee op got moved to early December so she's a bit torn about going.
Arjun had his second interview at the bank on Tuesday. Thinks it went ok but they asked loads about Python and he blanked. Should hear by Friday. Need to text him Friday evening either way.
Katarzyna's daughter Zosia has tonsillitis again, third time since summer. GP finally referring her to ENT. Kasia's exhausted, barely sleeping. Drop round some soup this weekend.

Long call with Amara. She's applied for the head of comms role at the council, closing date next Wednesday, and asked if I'd read her cover letter. Her brother Femi is back from Lagos sometime next week for a month. She sounded stretched thin honestly, said work's been brutal.
Fatima back from Japan. Two weeks, Tokyo then Kyoto, loved it. Jet lag still awful. Her husband got food poisoning on the last day in Osaka lol.
Alessia's dad had a fall Saturday, broke his wrist. He's 82 and lives alone in Bari so she's flying out tomorrow and not sure for how long. Check in with her midweek.
Note to self: renew passport before the end of the month. Lisbon flights are booked for early March.
Fang and Ming are off to Vancouver over the summer to see Ming's parents, they're taking the kids for the first time. 11 hour flight with a 2 year old, rather them than me.
Vikram didn't get the Deloitte job. Gutted, he'd been through four rounds. Said he's going to take a break from applying until after Christmas. Message him next week, maybe a pint.
Anya mentioned her knee's been bad since the half marathon, physio thinks it's IT band. She's got a scan next Thursday.
Joanna Lee - met at Laura's. Works in clinical trials at AstraZeneca, lives in Ely, mad about bouldering. Her partner's called Dawit, he's a nurse.
Laura's interview for the deputy head post is on Monday. She's really nervous, keeps saying she's not ready. Don't forget to send her good luck Sunday night!

Caught up with Fern at the school gate. Her son Kai broke his collarbone at rugby on Wednesday, in a sling for six weeks. He's gutted to miss the tour to Ireland at half term. Fern's covering extra shifts so her mum is doing pickups. Her birthday's next Saturday btw, she said she's desperate for a decent pair of walking boots.
Natasha's flight to Melbourne is Thursday night. Going for three months to see her sister Valentina who's just had a baby. Wish her a good trip Weds.
Femi got the job!! Starts at Arup in a fortnight. Must send congrats.
Alice called. Her mum's been admitted with pneumonia, Royal Free, probably in for the week. Alice is trying to work from the hospital. Ring her tomorrow after lunch. She said not to visit yet.
Magda's trip to Krakow is off, her dad's not well enough to travel with her. Instead she's doing a long weekend in Whitby with her friend Blessing. Back Monday.
Oisín's applying for a masters in Edinburgh, deadline mid January. Wants a reference from me. Also his dog Murphy needs surgery on his hip sometime next week, poor lad's stressed about the vet bill.
Adriana Reyes - new neighbour at 14. Moved from Valencia, teaches Spanish at the sixth form college, vegetarian. Two kids, Mateo and Lucía, one in Year 3 with Ellie.
Jonah had his tonsils out on Monday and is still on soup and ice cream. Said it's way worse as an adult. Back at work maybe Monday? Should drop off some films for him.
Quick one: Aiko's in Seoul for a work conference next week, then a few days in Busan. Asked me to water her plants Tuesday and Friday.

Mihai had the phone interview with Spotify yesterday. Went well apparently, they want him in Stockholm for a final round in early November. He's never flown alone so a bit anxious. His girlfriend Francesca might go too. Remind me to ask him on Friday if the dates are confirmed.
Wiremu and his wife flying back to Auckland for Christmas, first time in five years. Leaving 18th Dec, back mid January.
Kai Zhou - Fern's nephew, not her son! Doing a gap year in Vietnam, flies out end of the month. Fern a bit worried.
Francesca's little boy has chickenpox so she's off all this week. Andre's taking over her Thursday shift. Message Frankie to see if she needs anything from the shops.
Andre's mum has been diagnosed with early dementia. He told me at lunch, really quiet about it. They're seeing a specialist in a fortnight. I need to check in on him next week, not push it though.

Big catch-up with Alejandro and Valentina over dinner. They're finally doing the Patagonia trip, three weeks over Easter, flying into Santiago. Alejandro's applied for a sabbatical, hears back end of the month. Valentina's mum broke her hip in August and is still in rehab so they're nervous about being so far away. Val also mentioned she's reading everything by Isabel Allende before they go, and she's after the new one in hardback for her birthday next month. Their dog Chispa is going to her sister's.
Dawit got shortlisted for the charge nurse role, interview is next Tuesday at 10. He wants to do a practice run with me this weekend. I'm doing Saturday morning.
Blessing's been off sick for two weeks with long Covid symptoms again. Says she can't get through a day without napping. Struggling with it more than she lets on.
Sofia texted from Lima - landed safe, wedding was amazing. Her mum's op went fine back home too. Ask her how the flight back is next week.
Booked dentist for next Tuesday 8:30. Car MOT also due end of month.
Katarzyna says Zosia's ENT appointment is the 12th. Kasia's partner is taking the morning off to go with them. Zosia's terrified of needles.
Arjun didn't get the bank job but they've asked him to apply for a junior role on a different team. He's in two minds. Also he's off to Goa with his parents over Christmas.
Ming says Fang's back went out lifting the suitcase down from the loft lol. Physio Monday. Vancouver trip still on, just.
Amara got the interview for the comms role! It's sometime the week after next, they're confirming. She wants to do mock questions with me. Femi's flight got delayed so he lands Sunday now not Friday.
Laura's deputy head interview - she got it!! Starts after Easter. Need to send flowers to school before Friday.
Vikram's dad is in hospital, heart thing, stable now. Vik driving up to Leeds every weekend. Didn't really want to talk about it. Should ring him Sunday evening.
Met Natasha's sister Valentina on FaceTime, baby is called Isla and is gorgeous. Natasha's having a blast in Melbourne but says the heat is unreal.
Fatima's thinking of applying to do a PhD in Kyoto, totally fell in love with it. Big step, her husband's not keen. Deadline early March.

Fern says Kai's collarbone is healing faster than expected, might be out of the sling in a fortnight. He's still annoyed about missing the Ireland tour. Fern's birthday Saturday - grab boots voucher from Cotswold.
Joanna asked if I know anyone hiring in data science - she's been made redundant from the trials team, last day end of November. She's surprisingly upbeat. Pass her CV to Femi at Arup.
Aiko back from Korea. Brought me back face masks. Said the Busan bit was the highlight, ate way too much.

Alice's mum is out of hospital, home Saturday, on oxygen for a bit. Alice is staying with her through next week. Her husband Jonah's holding the fort with the twins. Send Alice a care package, she loves those Lindt truffles.
Oisín's dog Murphy came through the hip op fine. Now on crate rest for six weeks, Oisín is losing his mind. Reference for Edinburgh - need to write it before 10 Jan.

Talked to Magda - she had a big interview yesterday with the NHS trust for the project manager job. Two panel members and a presentation. She thinks she bombed the presentation. Hears back Thursday or Friday. Her son's had a rotten cold all week too so she's had no sleep.
Adriana mentioned her husband's flying back to Spain next Tuesday because his father is having bypass surgery. She's on her own with the kids for a fortnight. Offer to do Thursday school run.
Anya's scan came back - small meniscus tear, not IT band. Surgery maybe early in the new year. She's gutted about the London marathon. Ask her how she's feeling about it all next week.
Mihai's Stockholm interview is the 5th, flight out the night before. Francesca isn't going in the end, she couldn't get time off. Text him good luck on the 4th.
Dawit's charge nurse interview went really well. They said they'd let him know within a week. Fingers crossed. His partner Joanna's thrilled for him either way.

Lunch with Valentina. She's applying for jobs in Madrid, wants to move back closer to her parents, her dad's not been well since summer. Alejandro's open to it if his sabbatical comes through. Wants to visit sometime in spring to look at flats.
Wiremu's daughter Aroha is in hospital with appendicitis, op tonight. He sounded shaken. Text him tomorrow morning.
Jonah Hughes aka Jono - Alice's husband, the one who does the triathlons. Training for Ironman Lanzarote next May. Gluten free.
Pick up prescription and post Mum's card before Thursday.
Femi's first week at Arup done. Loves it, team's lovely, but the commute's killing him. Thinking of moving closer to King's Cross sometime in the new year.
Blessing's finally got an appointment at the long Covid clinic, early December. She's hopeful. Her sister Amara's coming down to stay that week. I should offer to drive her there.

Kai's back from Vietnam early, he got dengue fever and was in hospital in Hoi An for 5 days. Fern flew out to bring him home last weekend. He's recovering at hers now but very weak. She's shattered. Call Fern this week, maybe Wednesday. And ask about the travel insurance claim, she's having a nightmare with it.
Had a good chat with Francesca Santos at the work do. She's training to be a pilot on the side, does her first solo flight sometime this spring. Nervous but excited. Cat called Biscotti.
Natasha's back from Australia on Sunday. Wants to meet for brunch that week. Missed her.
Alejandro got the sabbatical approved!! Six months from April. Valentina called to tell me before he could. Patagonia then Madrid. Congrats card for them both, and a bottle of the good stuff.
Nothing much today. Rained all day, sorted the spare room.
